sn52.1:1.2: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Anuruddho Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2.
sn52.1:1.3: Atha kho āyasmato Anuruddhassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn52.1:1.4: Yesaṃ kesañci cattāro satipaṭṭhānā viraddhā || viraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī ||
sn52.1:1.5: Yesaṃ kesañci cattāro satipaṭṭhānā āraddhā || āraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī ti || || 3.
sn52.1:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Moggalāno āyasmato Anuruddhassa cetasā cetoparivitakkam aññāya seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitam vā bāham pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāham sammiñjeyya || evam eva āyasmato Anuruddhassa sammukhe pātur ahosi || || 4.
sn52.1:2.2: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Moggalāno āyasmantam Anuruddham etad avoca || ||
sn52.1:2.3: Kittāvatā nu kho āvuso Anuruddha bhikkhuno cattāro satipaṭṭhānā āraddhā hontīti || || 5.
sn52.1:3.1: Idhāvuso bhikkhu ajjhattaṃ kāye samudayadhammānupassī viharati || pa [pe] || ajjhattaṃ kāye vayadhammānupassī viharati || ajjhattam kāye samudayavayadhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 6.
sn52.1:3.2: Bahiddhā kāye vayadhammānupassī viharati || la [pe] || bahiddhā kāye samudayavayadhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 7.
sn52.1:3.3: Ajjhattabahidhā kāye samudayadhammānupassī viharati || ajjhattabahiddhā kāye vayadhammānupassī viharati || ajjhattabahiddhā kāye samudayavayadhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 8.
sn52.1:4.1: So sace ākaṅkhati Appatikkūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti || paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati || ||
sn52.1:4.2: Sace ākaṅkhati Paṭikkūle appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti || appaṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati || ||
sn52.1:4.3: Sa ce ākaṅkhati Appaṭikkule ca paṭikkule ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti patikkūlasaññī tattha viharati || ||
sn52.1:4.4: Sa ce ākaṅkhati Patikkūpe ca appaṭikkūle ca appatikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti || appatikkūlasaññī tattha viharati || ||
sn52.1:4.5: Sa ce ākaṅkhati Appaṭikkūlañca paṭikkūlañca tadubhayam abhinivajjetvā upekhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajāno ti || upekhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno || || 9.
sn52.1:5.1: Ajjhattaṃ vedanāsu samudayadhammanupassī viharati || ajjhattaṃ vedanāsu vayadhammānupassī viharati || ajjhattaṃ vedanāsu samudayavayadhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyyaloke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 10.
sn52.1:5.2: Bahiddhā vedanāsu samudayadhadhammānupassī viharati || bahiddhā vedanāsu vayadhammānupassī viharati || bahiddhā vedanāsu samudayavayadhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyyaloke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 11.
sn52.1:5.3: Ajjhattabahiddhā vedanāsu samudayadhammānupassī viharati || ajjhattabahiddhā vedanāsu vayadhammānupassī viharati || ajjhattabahiddhā vedanāsu samudayavayadhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam || || 12.
sn52.1:7.3: Ajjhattabahiddhā citte samudayadhammānupassī viharati || ajjhattabahiddhā citte vaya- || ajjhattabahiddhā citte samudayavayadhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī || la || abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 16.
sn52.1:9.3: Ajjhattabahiddhā dhammesu samudayadhammānupassī viharati || ajjhattabahiddhā dhammesu vayadhammānupassī viharati || ajjhattabahiddhā dhammesu samudayavayadhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 20.
sn52.1:10.1: So sa ce ākaṅkhati Appaṭikūle paṭikūlasaññī vihareyyan ti paṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati || la ||
sn52.1:10.3: Ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno cattāro satipaṭṭhānā āraddhā hontī ti || || 1.
